# Vendored libraries (V9)

| File | Package | Version | License |
|---|---|---|---|
| `qrcode.js` | [qrcode-generator](https://www.npmjs.com/package/qrcode-generator) | 2.0.4 | MIT (header in file) |
| `jsQR.js` | [jsqr](https://www.npmjs.com/package/jsqr) | 1.4.0 | Apache-2.0 (`LICENSE-jsQR.txt`) |

Copied unchanged from the npm tarballs (`dist/`). `jsQR.js` is loaded only when the browser
has no `BarcodeDetector` with QR support (for example iOS Safari).
